text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Oh my, excuse me.
Right in front of you, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Actually, while I was reading a magazine last night,
I came across a kanji puzzle section.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't help getting carried away,
and by the time I solved them all,
it was already dawning outside.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: However, slipping into bed wrapped in that sense of accomplishment was simply exquisite~♪
It seems Mejiro Bright is lacking sleep...
